name: Wild Magic
label: Sorcerous Origin
summary: Chaos incarnate — your spells can trigger a wild surge with wildly unpredictable results.
flavor: Your innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You might have endured exposure to raw magic, or perhaps a wild-magic wielder was among your ancestors. Whatever the case, this chaos roils within you, waiting for any outlet.
playstyle: The most chaotic and most fun-dependent origin. Tides of Chaos gives you free advantage, Bend Luck manipulates any roll, and Controlled Chaos at 14th finally gives you some say in what the surge does.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description:
Your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect.

The table's 50 results range from the harmless (you turn blue, flowers sprout) to the dangerous (you cast *fireball* centered on yourself) to the extraordinary (you regain all expended sorcery points, or a *fireball*-scale effect goes off). If the effect is a spell, it's too wild to be affected by Metamagic.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: You can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use it again — unless the DM has you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table before then, which immediately restores the use.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: You have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: You gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: The harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again, and add that roll to the damage. You can use this feature only once per turn.
